final_assessment: Seven decisions settled under R-crc-3, three open questions with standing recommendations, four rejected options. The shape: the severity ladder is defined by consequence in orbit-conventions with an evidence tax on CRITICAL (a reproduction), enforced at the internal emit write gate and surfaced-not-regraded for external findings; SUGGESTIONs stop gating by making convergence clauses (b) and (c) substantive-only for every reviewed gate, which supersedes issue #8's third-confirm-value mechanism while shipping R-d-10's intent exactly; R-crc-4's blind pair becomes a fifth cadence entry whose blindness is computed from the trail (no walk of either pass's own findings between them) with byte-exact same-state named as a v1 limit; spec-driven v4 sets the system cadence to [blind-pair, in-context], the trailing slot surviving as the walk check rc03 will rename verification; the review budget counts independent passes per mode and its exhaustion is the sixth gate state budget-exhausted, with consumers routed through one exported isUnconverged predicate; and the gate reason becomes the teaching surface, naming the open blind pair before the cost is sunk. Sized at two capabilities (orbit-engine-gates, orbit-conventions) plus the schema, inside R-crc-1.
